column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules. Columns: <plugin id> <TAB> <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL> <TAB> <comment>
# FAIL = breaks the workflow. WARN = shown in the report only. IGNORE = suppressed (justify every one).
# Anything not listed here uses the ZAP default (WARN).

column3: (Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set) every page must send the baseline CSP
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) pages AND static files; see public/.htaccess
(Server Leaks Information via X-Powered-By) must stay hidden
(Cookie Without Secure Flag) staging/production run on HTTPS; set SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true
(CSP) KNOWN: script-src/style-src still need 'unsafe-inline' (inline scripts + onclick handlers) and 'unsafe-eval' (Livewire/Alpine). Tracked: move to nonces, then change this to FAIL
(Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion) KNOWN: CDN scripts have no SRI. Tracked: self-host or pin + add integrity hashes
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag) Expected for Laravel's XSRF-TOKEN cookie only; investigate if any OTHER cookie is listed
(Big Redirect Detected) false positive: Laravel's standard ~400 byte redirect page
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments) comments in third-party/minified JS
(Storable and Cacheable Content) informational on public pages
(Timestamp Disclosure - Unix) numbers in JS bundles, not timestamps
